EVIDENCE BEFORE RELEASE

Agent Owned Work

Agent Owned Work workflow for coding agents. Use when the agent is asked to edit a repository.

Workflow

  1. Identify the requested outcome and supplied evidence.
  2. Inspect the target, make the authorized edit with tools, verify the diff, report actual results.
  3. Verify the output contract and preserve uncertainty.

Populated example

Request: Fix the README typo.

Edit the typo and verify the diff; if tools are unavailable report that limitation.

Use the helper

tool_capability
